lines.en: The iron bars slide apart a hand's width.

lines.zh: 门轴转得很涩，吱呀作响
lines.en: The hinge grinds, stiff and loud.
I shift across the gap in the wall.

lines.zh: 半扇门先动，另半扇跟着
lines.en: One leaf moves, then the other follows.

lines.zh: 铁条互相碰出低沉的响
lines.en: The bars knock together, low and dull.
I travel along my own frame.
Gravel crunches under my base.
I know the road outside.
I leave the opening dead center.
The chains on either side pull taut.
I stop, then ease forward a bit.
My shadow is sliced by the frame.
Closed tight. Not a tremor.
Old rust coats my iron.
The latch clicks once.
The chains pull taut; I do not move.

lines.zh: 风从门栅间挤过去，呜呜响。
lines.en: Wind squeezes through my bars and moans.
Wind moans through my grid.
The posts on either side hold firm.
I don't move unless commanded.
Rust flakes down onto the ground.
Everyone passes through me.
I remember every opening.
The oil in my hinge dried long ago.

lines.zh: 静得能听见远处的旗声
lines.en: Quiet enough to hear distant banners.
I rest my weight on the frame.
You stand outside, looking up at me.
Do I know your colors?

lines.zh: 铁栅的缝只够看清你半张脸
lines.en: Through my bars I see half your face.
My latch sits ready.
To enter, you speak first.

lines.zh: 你身上没有本营的标记
lines.en: You carry no mark of this camp.
I narrow my gap by an inch.
Rust looks like old blood in the light.
I weigh you in silence.
Step back and I close.
The yard beyond is mine to keep.
I turn my hinge a single degree.

lines.zh: 你的影子投在我铁条上
lines.en: Your shadow falls across my bars.
This look is not permission.
Standing in the way is my duty.
Don't push me with your hands.
I've seen more armies than you.
Now. Name yourself.
A dent sinks into my iron.
My hinge lets out a long groan.
I rock, then steady.
Rust flakes off in a shower.
My latch loosens a fraction.
My leaf shifts half an inch.
No pain, but it's loud.
I press my gate harder shut.
You hear the iron ringing.
That sound carries a long way.
What is that in your hands?
Iron doesn't eat.

lines.zh: 但我会为一把钥匙让路
lines.en: But I'll open for a key.
That's not a key. I can tell.

lines.zh: 把钥匙举到锁孔那么高。
lines.en: Raise the key to the height of the lock.
A camp seal? No. Wrong.

lines.zh: 我认得那面旗，不是你的
lines.en: I know that banner. It isn't yours.
Any closer and I lock.
That's a long way from tempting.
Set it on the threshold.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，铁栅嗡嗡响。
lines.en: You hit me and my iron bars hum.
I give no ground.
The bars didn't bend.
The shock numbs your hand.
I shudder once, then hold.
Don't shove. I'm heavier than you think.
My hinge creaks once. That's a warning.
Step back and I'll go quiet.
Rust smears your sleeve.
That doesn't count as breaching me.

lines.zh: 门与门之间没有这回事
lines.en: Gates have no such thing.
The wall and I are a pair.
My other half is the anchor pin.
Together we make a pass.
Hinges touching is our greeting.
I keep this end. It keeps that one.
We open together and close together.
Nothing else is needed.
We hold until we rust through.
That is a gate's whole life.
I can't hold anything.

lines.zh: 铁条之间的缝会漏下去
lines.en: It falls through the gap between my bars.
Leave it on the threshold.
I wedge it in my frame.
This would work as a wedge.
I hold it down against the wind.
It glints at my base.
No one takes it past me.
My hinge turns once. Consider it received.
Leave it. I'll remember where.
The iron gate drops. The way is shut.
I close my gap.
The latch bites home with a click.
The chains pull to their limit.
My hinge begins to turn.
What you hear isn't wind.
This ground belongs to us.
I stand in the gateway and don't yield.
My bars drop and bite the soil.
Dust shakes loose from my frame.
To get in, open me yourself.
I drop all my weight.
The gap narrows to a finger's width.
I wait for you to try.
My faction's banner still flies.

lines.zh: 想进去，得先过我这一关。
lines.en: To get in, you must get past me.
I watch that patch of ground by the gate.
Every move you make creaks my hinge.
I press my leaves tighter.
The light between my bars wavers.
Locked means locked.
Go around the wall. It's thicker.
Not one stone in my frame has shifted.
I have more rust than you have patience.
You're hunting a gap. There is none.
Night falls. I still won't loosen.
This pass recognizes no one.
Only my faction passes.
Setting down your torch changes nothing.
I'm still standing here.
Until someone comes to relieve me.
Until then, the gate stays shut.
That's how it's always been.
I've thrown both bars.
You can't tell how many leaves I have.
The iron still holds warmth.
My leaf swings and hits your shoulder.
My bars scrape your arm.

lines.zh: 落下的门头擦到你的头
lines.en: The falling gate grazes your head.

lines.zh: 这一下把你推出了门槛
lines.en: That shoves you off the threshold.
My hinge swings out once.
Rust rains down on you.
You weren't caught between the leaves. Lucky.
I close my gap completely.
A gate doesn't chase.
But if you stand in my arc,
that's your own doing.
Iron on iron makes a dull sound.

lines.zh: 你的武器在铁上弹开了
lines.en: Your weapon skips off my iron.
I'm only closing.
It closes very quickly.
Don't put your hand in.
You're too late now.
The gate is shut.
Something stands up in the gateway.
The iron bars land first. Heavy.
My frame jolts and dust falls.
The wall here knows me.
Rust lies on me like old paint.
I set my leaves to the hinge.
Banners move inside the gate.
I hold here. No one tears me down.
The chains are hung.
The mud on my threshold is fresh.
I open a single crack first.
Let's see what's out there.
Pleasant breeze. I don't like it.
The yard inside needs guarding.
I stand here now.
This gate will stay until it rusts.
Until it rusts through.
Or someone takes it.
Fire heats my iron and the rust cracks.
I drop and sink into the soil.
Water floods my hinge and it won't turn.
The blast knocks my leaf askew.
An arrow pings off my iron.
This force seeps into my iron.
Iron doesn't starve, but it can dry out.
Lightning runs a loop around my frame.
The ground beneath my frame is gone.
